BiblicalUsage: Jezaniah is an Israelite, a captain who came to Gedaliah after the fall of Jerusalem. In Jeremiah 40:8, Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite. The fuller story is told on the Jezaniah, Son of Hoshaiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jezaniah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
